title: Super-Brownian limits and the $k$-point function for high-dimensional percolation
summary: We prove that there exist positive constants $A$ and $V$ such that the high-dimensional critical percolation $k$-point function is given by \[ T_{p_c}(x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_{k}) \sim V^{k-2} A^{2k-3} \sum_{T\in \mathsf{Tr}(k)} \sum_{\substack{Φ:V(T)\to \mathbb{Z}^d \\ Φ(i)=x_i \forall 1\leq i \leq k}} \prod_{\substack{u,v\in V(T)\\u\sim v}}G(Φ(u),Φ(v)) \] as $\min_{i\neq j}\|x_i-x_j\|\to \infty$, where $\mathsf{Tr}(k)$ is a set of isomorphism class representatives of trees with $k$ labelled leaves $\{1,\ldots,k\}$ and unlabelled internal vertices all of which have degree $3$ and $G$ is the…
